summary: Operations analyst with seven years turning warehouse, transport and supplier data into the weekly forecasts operations teams plan against. Built weekly demand-forecasting models in Python and SQL across 2,400 SKUs that cut forecast error from 22% to 14%, with the dbt models and Power BI reporting behind them.
p1: Your depot managers can only plan around an inventory forecast they trust, week after week, on chilled and ambient lines alike. At Brindle & Hart Logistics I built the weekly demand-forecasting models in Python and SQL that cut forecast error from 22% to 14% across 2,400 SKUs.
p2: Larkspur runs 14 temperature-controlled depots across the North of England. Chilled stock that waits too long is stock written off, and at Oakmere Foods I modelled shelf-life and order patterns for chilled lines, informing order-quantity changes that reduced write-offs by 18% over two quarters.

posting:
Larkspur Freight & Cold Chain is hiring an Inventory Planning Analyst in Manchester.

You will own the weekly inventory and replenishment forecasts for our chilled and ambient
distribution network, and turn them into plans our depot managers can act on.

What you bring:
- Strong SQL and Python for forecasting and analysis
- Experience building demand or inventory forecasting models
- dbt or similar for reliable data pipelines
- Power BI dashboards for operations teams
- Confident working with suppliers and depot managers
- Experience with a forecasting suite is a plus

Hybrid: two days a week at our the Salford depot office. Salary GBP 42,000 to 48,000.
